patterns.note: Full-bleed lifestyle imagery and video are used extensively to showcase products in context, often serving as section backgrounds.
A dramatic, elegant serif display font is contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body and UI elements, creating a sophisticated typographic hierarchy.
A sophisticated neutral palette of white, light beige, and black forms the base, with subtle, context-driven accent colors (like a light green for promotional banners) providing visual interest.

A multi-stage sticky header system is employed: an initial promotional bar disappears on scroll, the main navigation then becomes sticky, and a secondary promotional banner slides in below it, also becoming sticky.
Product grids often feature a mix of clean product shots and aspirational lifestyle images, breaking the uniformity of typical e-commerce layouts.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered sticky header system. Initially, a top promotional bar is visible. Upon scrolling, this bar disappears, and the main navigation becomes fixed at the top. Further scrolling reveals a secondary promotional banner that slides into view below the sticky navigation, also becoming fixed. The hero video acts as a background element that scrolls beneath these sticky elements.
Full-bleed hero video and large lifestyle imagery are used to create an immersive brand experience, often with text overlays for key messages, leveraging the 'video-hero' animation tech.
Product displays integrate a mix of clean product photography and aspirational lifestyle shots within flexible grid layouts, often using a light beige background to differentiate sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif display font for hero headlines (~4-5x body) contrasted with a clean, balanced sans-serif for body and UI elements, with some bold uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — primarily on buttons and input fields, maintaining a clean edge elsewhere.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — particularly in hero and lifestyle sections, with balanced density in product grids and footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dramatic, elegant serif font for hero headlines, combined with full-bleed lifestyle video and imagery, creates a high-fashion, editorial feel that elevates the product beyond typical e-commerce. The multi-stage sticky header system also adds a refined, dynamic touch to the user experience.
